entries.title: Revelation of John 18:1
segments: After this I saw another angel, descending from Heaven, invested with great authority; and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:2
segments: With a mighty voice he cried-- 'She has fallen! She has fallen--Babylon the Great! She has become an abode of demons, a stronghold of every wicked spirit, a stronghold of every foul and hateful bird.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:3
segments: For, after drinking the maddening wine of her licentiousness, all the nations have fallen; while all the kings of the earth have had licentious intercourse with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich through the excess of her luxury.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:4
segments: Then I heard another voice from Heaven saying--'Come out of her, my People, that you may not participate in her sins, and that you may not suffer from the Curses inflicted upon her.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:5
segments: For her sins are heaped up to the heavens, and God has not forgotten her misdeeds.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:6
segments: Pay her back the treatment with which she has treated you; yes, repay twice over what her actions deserve; in the cup which she mixed for you, mix for her as much again;

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:7
segments: for her self-glorification and her luxury, give her now an equal measure of torture and misery. In her heart she says 'I sit here a queen; no widow am I; I shall never know misery.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:8
segments: Therefore in one day shall these Curses befall her--death, misery, and famine, and she shall be utterly consumed by fire; for mighty is the Lord God who condemned her.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:9
segments: All the kings of the earth who had licentious intercourse with her and shared her luxury will weep and lament over her, when they see the smoke from the burning city,

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:10
segments: while they stand at a distance, horrified at her torture, and cry-- 'Alas! Alas! Great City! O mighty City of Babylon! In a single hour your judgement fell.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:11
segments: And the merchants of the earth weep and wail over her, because no longer does any one buy their cargoes--

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:12
segments: their cargoes of gold, or silver, or precious stones, or pearls, or fine linen, or purple robes, or silk, or scarlet cloth; nor their many scented woods; nor their many articles of ivory; nor their many articles of choicest wood, or brass, or iron, or marble;

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:13
segments: nor their cinnamon, or spice, or incense, or perfumes. or frankincense, or wine, or oil, or fine flour, or wheat, or cattle, or sheep; nor their horses, or chariots, or slaves; nor the bodies and souls of men.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:14
segments: The fruit that your soul craved is no longer within your reach, and all dainties and luxuries are lost to you, never to be found again.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:15
segments: The merchants who sold these things, and grew rich by her, will stand at a distance weeping and wailing, horrified at her torture, and crying--

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:16
segments: 'Alas! Alas! Great City! O City clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet cloth! O City adorned with gold ornaments, and precious stones, and pearls!

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:17
segments: In a single hour your vast wealth vanished.' Every ship's captain and all who sail to any port, and sailors, and all who get their living from the sea, stood at a distance,

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:18
segments: and seeing the smoke from the burning city, cried-- 'What city can compare with the Great City?'

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:19
segments: They threw dust on their heads, and, as they wept and wailed, they cried-- 'Alas! Alas! Great City! All who have ships on the sea grew rich through her magnificence. In a single hour it has vanished.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:20
segments: Rejoice over her, O Heaven, and People of Christ, and Apostles, and Prophets, for God has avenged you on her!

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:21
segments: Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and threw it into the sea, crying-- 'So shall Babylon, the Great City, be violently overthrown, never more to be seen.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:22
segments: No more shall the music of harpers, or minstrels, or flute players, or trumpeters be heard in you, no more shall any worker, skilled in any art, be found in you; no more shall the sound of a mill be heard in you;

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:23
segments: no more shall the light of a lamp shine in you; no more shall the voices of bridegroom and bride be heard in you. Your merchants were the great men of the earth, for all the nations were deceived by your magical charms.

entries.title: Revelation of John 18:24
segments: Yes, and in her was to be found the blood of the Prophets and of Christ's People, and of all who have been put to death upon the earth.'
